capability: A structural engineer can find, inspect and verify governed project drawings and move between drawing context and evidence without repository knowledge or authority confusion.

slices.goal: Expose the existing N12 document and drawing patrimony as a usable library/register.
slices.promotion_note: Technical preparation exists; human/promotion evidence is evaluated at the integrated B1 boundary.

slices.goal: Deliver the drawing viewer with zoom/pan/fit/90-degree display rotation and evidence overlays.
slices.promotion_note: Viewer preparation is display-only and remains noncanonical until integrated B1 promotion.

slices.goal: Add DocumentMap and document-understanding states without treating machine extraction as authority.
slices.promotion_note: Document-understanding validation does not imply DOC or structural binding.

slices.goal: Add intake/versioning for new documents with browser-local hash, duplicate/version analysis and human classification review.
slices.open_boundary: Private document-byte persistence remains separately governed; metadata analysis alone cannot create SourceVersion.

slices.goal: Integrate OCR/vector/AI candidates into DocumentMap with explicit provenance and review state.
slices.promotion_note: Machine output cannot self-promote engineering or documentary truth.

slices.goal: Create/select EvidenceRegion candidates from the drawing workspace while preserving F2 authority rules.
slices.open_boundary: Candidate persistence/promotion remains separate from F2 EvidenceRegion authority.

slices.goal: Prepare a measurable Acceptance Lab for the complete Documents -> Drawings -> Evidence journey.
slices.observed_result: Deterministic instrument behavior validated; direct participant use exposed role/telemetry/governance overload.

slices.goal: Implement and execute Human-Centred Acceptance v2 with participant, observation, reviewer and receipt layers separated.
slices.promotion_rule: B1 can be promoted only after no non-compensable blocker remains and the accepted immutable revision passes required Production smoke.

stop_rules: Do not release B2 while B1 document/drawing/evidence journey remains incomplete.
Do not re-upload existing immutable N12 sources merely to make the UI work.
Do not turn viewer rotation into SourceVersion/Page/EvidenceRegion mutation.
Do not promote OCR/vector/AI findings without their declared human/engineering gate.
Do not mark a task successful if the user reaches the wrong document or believes a derived aid is primary authority.
Do not treat the B1.7 v1 instrument PASS as HVA PASS after the observed participant-surface defect.
Do not let the participant self-approve the release or operate receipt governance.
Do not use acceptance evidence from a different immutable revision to satisfy B1 promotion.
